summary: Neuro-Cybernetic Protocol: the wire contract, Rust, Python, C, C++ and TypeScript surfaces, conformance vectors and evidence for the untagged NCP 1.0 candidate. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its operational facts for tools.

entry_documents.role: registry of every code generator, its outputs and every tracked asset
owner decisions, including when the v1.0.0 tag may follow

delivery.merge: Commit in a separate worktree from origin/main, run the applicable gates, then push to main directly or through a merged branch.
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution or co-author trailers

gates.when: after any tracked change, with the change staged
a code generator, asset, fixture or dependency changes
a diagram or its generator changes
agent-index.json or a path it names changes
a protocol, schema or vector changes

generated.regenerate: python3 scripts/generate_supply_chain_evidence.py, with the pinned advisory database prepared as in scripts/check.sh

frozen.reason: frozen candidate and released wire baselines; scripts/check_wire_baseline.py and scripts/check_released_baselines.py verify them
preregistration fixed before the timed runs of 13 October 2026; PREREGISTRATION.sha256 and results/results.json record its digest
raw output of the timed runs; the files differ from the files as written only by the path redaction that results/REDACTION.json records
raw output of the NEST 3.10.0 benchmark run and its same-session control; a new measurement needs a new file

ecosystem.relation: observer and raw-advisory publisher pinned to the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate
commander adapter pinned to the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate
not an NCP peer; receives no NCP role receipt
